BiblicalUsage: Chakkah is a hook, an angle for fishing. God asks Job whether he can draw out Leviathan with a hook, Isaiah says the fishers who cast angle into the Nile will mourn, and Habakkuk says the Chaldeans take up all men with the angle and gather them in their net.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the hook is God's question and man's net in turn: He asks Job if he can hook Leviathan, and the Chaldeans hook whole nations. Only one of them is fishing with God's leave.
